203 days from 1299-03-08.  
1299 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, Gregorian rules apply).  
March 8 + 203 days: March has 31 days → days left in March = 31 - 8 = 23 → 203 - 23 = 180 left.  
April (30) → 150 left, May (31) → 119 left, June (30) → 89 left, July (31) → 58 left, August (31) → 27 left, September 30 → 27 days into September = September 27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1299-09-27
